note: all three are Portuguese comarca towns. Miranda do Douro sits ON the frontier and is Portuguese; no Spanish settlement is engraved anywhere inside this cell, so the one-crown rule applies here exactly as it does inland.

note: Portuguese Estremadura and the Ribatejo, the crown's own heartland around the capital.

note: the cell holds Vigo and Ribadavia, which are Spanish, together with Braga, Valenca and Melgaco, which are Portuguese. The wash network is open across the Minho here, so the cell can carry no owner.
